settings_disclaimer.name: settings_disclaimer
settings_disclaimer.value:
("app_settings"."disclaimer_acknowledged" = 0 AND "app_settings"."disclaimer_acknowledged_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("app_settings"."disclaimer_acknowledged" = 1 AND "app_settings"."disclaimer_acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL)

grade_other_label.name: grade_other_label
grade_other_label.value: "grades"."company" <> 'other' OR ("grades"."company_label" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("grades"."company_label")) > 0)

ic_status_shape.name: ic_status_shape
ic_status_shape.value:
("installed_catalogs"."status" = 'absent' AND "installed_catalogs"."version" IS NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."sha256" IS NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."installed_at" IS NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."active_ref" IS NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."schema_version" IS NULL)
    OR ("installed_catalogs"."status" IN ('installed','failed') AND "installed_catalogs"."version" IS NOT NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."installed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."active_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "installed_catalogs"."schema_version" >= 1)

owned_one_reference.name: owned_one_reference
owned_one_reference.value:
("owned_cards"."catalog_card_id" IS NOT NULL AND "owned_cards"."custom_card_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("owned_cards"."catalog_card_id" IS NULL AND "owned_cards"."custom_card_id" IS NOT NULL)

owned_catalog_snapshot.name: owned_catalog_snapshot
owned_catalog_snapshot.value: "owned_cards"."catalog_card_id" IS NULL OR ("owned_cards"."set_id" IS NOT NULL AND "owned_cards"."local_id" IS NOT NULL)

owned_purchase.name: owned_purchase
owned_purchase.value:
("owned_cards"."purchase_price_cents" IS NULL AND "owned_cards"."purchase_currency" IS NULL)
    OR ("owned_cards"."purchase_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "owned_cards"."purchase_currency" IS NOT NULL
      AND "owned_cards"."purchase_price_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND "owned_cards"."purchase_currency" IN ('USD','EUR'))

owned_manual.name: owned_manual
owned_manual.value:
("owned_cards"."manual_price_cents" IS NULL AND "owned_cards"."manual_price_currency" IS NULL)
    OR ("owned_cards"."manual_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "owned_cards"."manual_price_currency" IS NOT NULL
      AND "owned_cards"."manual_price_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND "owned_cards"."manual_price_currency" IN ('USD','EUR'))

scan_closed_at.name: scan_closed_at
scan_closed_at.value:
("scan_sessions"."status" = 'open' AND "scan_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("scan_sessions"."status" <> 'open' AND "scan_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

sync_counts.name: sync_counts
sync_counts.value:
"sync_state"."attempt" >= 1 AND "sync_state"."sets_done" >= 0 AND "sync_state"."cards_done" >= 0 AND "sync_state"."cards_failed" >= 0
    AND ("sync_state"."sets_total" IS NULL OR "sync_state"."sets_total" >= "sync_state"."sets_done")
    AND ("sync_state"."cards_total" IS NULL OR "sync_state"."cards_total" >= "sync_state"."cards_done" + "sync_state"."cards_failed")
